parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: Pipeline ID, which can be obtained from the pipeline link, such as https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/【PipelineId】/current.
